rules.liquidity: (volume_24h >= 100 OR open_interest >= 500) AND spread <= 5.0c (live uses lifetime volume; history has only last-hour and 24h volume, 24h used)
rules.edge: model_prob - fee-inclusive breakeven (props_ev.py Kalshi branch); sensitivity: model_prob - mid
rules.p_over: P(X >= threshold) = P(X > threshold - 0.5) from the predictive distribution
rules.flags: model_market_disagreement (>15 pts or ratio>2 under 20%) and kalshi_illiquid -> Pass; mean_far_from_line (>35%), missed_last_game, offense_pct_last<25% -> check (never Strong); kalshi_tail_price -> low confidence; rec_yds capped at Lean; n_prior<10 -> low confidence
rules.not_replicated: live_roles.py role overrides / week_roles role flags (no historical weekly role tables); role-adjusted rush_yds cap therefore vacuous
rules.one_bet: one bet per game-player-market: highest-EV Strong/Lean rung/side

projection_vs_market.method:
Market-implied median per game-player-market from the last pre-kick ladder. P(X>=k) = mid of the YES quote.
Usable rung = valid two-sided pre-kick quote AND spread <= 5c. Monotone fix: running minimum over increasing k.
The 50% crossing must be bracketed by two usable rungs that are adjacent in the listed pre-kick ladder (no one-sided or
wide rung between them); count markets add the trivial rung P(X>=0)=1. Median interpolated linearly on the half-point
line (k-0.5). Count markets also get the integer median (smallest m with P(X>=m+1) <= 0.5).
projection_vs_market.sample: 2026 weeks 1-9 player-games with a usable pre-kick ladder, our eligibility (>=3 prior games, min usage), a nflverse stat row, and a season-average benchmark
projection_vs_market.season_avg_rule: projection_accuracy.season_avgs: season-to-date mean if >=2 prior games this season, else prior-season mean, else fallback
caveats: Nothing here saw 2026 weeks 1-9 outcomes before predicting them: count markets are refit every week on prior weeks only; rush_yds/rec_yds frozen v2 mean models were fit on 2018-2023 (fine).
The live models/artifacts pickles (trained through 2026 wk10 TNF) are NOT used here; they would be in-sample.
Model/variant selection and the frozen v2 promotions used 2025 + 2026 wk1-9 test metrics (mild selection bias); dispersion was fit on 2024.
Count medians are integers; the market median is interpolated (continuous). mae_market_median_int is the like-for-like integer version.
Market median uses the mid of the last hourly pre-kick candle; ladders with one-sided/wide (>5c) rungs at the 50% crossing are skipped.
